overview: Outer Madness is the unstable threshold of Grieg’s End.
details: Spatial distortions twist the outer halls into impossible shapes. Grieg’s fractured psyche manifests as illusions, phantoms, and warped constructs. Travelers often become lost in looping corridors.
hooks: A phantom manifestation of Grieg appears briefly.
Warped constructs patrol a corridor that shifts angles.
A psychic pulse destabilizes nearby geometry.
